<!--
Roadmap items track committed work toward a specific target version
(rc.1, rc.2, rc.3, 2.0-final, 2.1, 2.2+). The project board groups
issues by these labels. See ROADMAP.md for the published roadmap.

If you're a community contributor proposing new direction: start in
GitHub Discussions (Ideas category) so the maintainer can scope +
shape before an issue lands here.
-->

## Theme

<!--
Pick one (also add the matching `theme:` label):
- `theme: trust+obs` — shadow mode, soundness model, observability, safety presets
- `theme: flaky` — flaky-test detection + tooling
- `theme: precision` — per-example attribution precision (eager_load, DBCleaner, AR-schema)
- `theme: docs+positioning` — README/CHANGELOG/COOKBOOK/ARCHITECTURE; landing/positioning
- `theme: analytics` — anti-pattern detection + dependency analytics + visualization
- `theme: ecosystem` — adjacent tooling, integrations, Minitest adapter, editor support
-->

- `roadmap: 2.1` — analytics + visualization minor
- `roadmap: 2.2+` — ecosystem / exploratory
-->
